verdicts.reason: Both lose the hero barrel photo, which shrinks to a thumbnail-sized sliver at the bottom, and both shrink the triangle logo to a tiny icon. That guts the brand imagery. A has a stray dark gradient bar across the middle that reads as a rendering artifact, and the watercolour texture floats loose at the top. B is worse arranged: the dash is stranded alone at the top, the headline sits far from the tagline, the texture fills dead space in the middle, the tagline is off the centre line, and the thumbnail and logo are pushed into the bottom-left corner. A at least keeps its elements on one centred axis.
